Charger is updated to the latest FW version.
To have the AC outlet working again, someone must to go the charger and check if FB1 and FC5 is tripped or not. It's a physical switch so it must be untripped.

additional_info.subject: ID0469307-DC/Si-D/PK- [MP / P3 170000287] AC Port is out of  Order CRM:03289000055
additional_info.body:
Hello Adnan, good afternoon.
I checked this charger right now and I can see this:
And
The Charging screen's presentation of 'time to 80% SoC' and 'time to 100% SoC' estimates has been refined in v8.1.4. The charger now evaluates the realism of these optional EV-provided values (in seconds) and will hide them if they are considered unrealistic, ensuring more reliable information for the user. The charging time is a parameter coming from EV and we just process it.
Regarding the kWh, I just checked 2 sessions and at the end the kWh is shown:
And
Can you please let me know what is failing? Maybe I didn't understand. If it's not sending kWh to backend that's because it's offline due to the Wireless being very weak signal:
As you can see the Signal strength is 0% which means we don't have internet.
Please let me know your feedback.
Br,
Francisco
